chain.title: Moonlight Pulled From Stone
chain.desc: Smelted from Silver Ore or Raw Silver; nearly every witch's tool in the mod is forged from it.

chain.title: It Screams When Pulled
chain.desc: Grown from Mandrake Seeds on tilled soil; the root binds the Book of Shadows and the Druid Band.

chain.title: A Name Sealed in Glass
chain.desc: Use an empty Taglock to collect a target's sample through the methods described in the book, such as approaching from behind or using its bed. Check the filled target before using it in a targeted effect.

chain.title: What the Fire Leaves Behind
chain.desc: Logs cooked on a campfire; the binding agent in every stick of chalk.

chain.title: Something Is Loose in the Nether
chain.desc: Hellhounds prowl the Nether and are the earliest reliable source of Demon Horn.

chain.title: A Cold Spot in the Room
chain.desc: Ghosts are the mod's only source of Ectoplasm.

chain.title: The Blade That Cuts Spirit
chain.desc: Use the Athame to gather bark and perform the interactions described in the Book of Shadows. Bark leads into the altar and cauldron branches, while the blade also has specialised creature-drop uses.

chain.title: Open the Grimoire
chain.desc: Make the Book of Shadows and read the entries unlocked by your discoveries. Keep it at the ritual area so you can check circles, power costs and ingredients before beginning.

chain.title: The Circle's Beating Heart
chain.desc: Load the Brazier with the ingredients for incense or a curse and light it as the book describes. It serves those processes; ordinary chalk-circle rituals use a Golden Glyph at their centre instead.

chain.title: Taken From a Burning Skull
chain.desc: Dropped by Hellhounds and by every greater demon; the summoning ritual will not run without one.

chain.title: Residue of the Restless
chain.desc: Defeat a Ghost and gather Ectoplasm for the spirit-related recipes. This is an independent creature-hunting branch, not a material that requires demon summoning first.

chain.title: Where the Power Pools
chain.desc: Build a Witch Altar near a varied natural area and inspect its magical power. Rituals spend that power, so develop the surrounding plants and altar arrangement before attempting expensive summons.

chain.title: Set the Brew Boiling
chain.desc: Prepare the Witch Cauldron and follow the book's brewing instructions for the mixture you want. Keep ingredients labelled so you can repeat a successful brew without guessing.

chain.title: Draw the First Circle
chain.desc: Draw the ritual's exact chalk circles in a clear area near the powered altar. The central mark uses Golden Chalk; ordinary Chalk is not a substitute for every ring.

chain.title: Sign, and Be Paid
chain.desc: Read the book's contract conditions and use the appropriate demon interaction to obtain a contract. Check its boon and duration before agreeing to the terms.

chain.title: Blood of the Ground
chain.desc: Distilled from Aconite, Spruce Bark and stone; the first of six oils that the advanced chalks demand.

chain.title: A Circle Drawn in Embers
chain.desc: Prepare Fiery Chalk through the brewing and crafting route. Use it only in the positions specified by the ritual, particularly the more dangerous summoning circles.

chain.title: Lines That Should Not Meet
chain.desc: Chalk mixed with Aqua Cerate and Grim Elixir; the outer ring of the binding and divination rituals.

chain.title: The Gilded Ring
chain.desc: Prepare Golden Chalk for the central glyph and any golden rings required by a ritual. Confirm the full pattern before placing the activation ingredients.

chain.title: Answer the Summons
chain.desc: Build the Summon Demon ritual with the required chalk pattern, altar power and ingredients. Prepare an arena before activating it, then defeat the summoned Demon and retrieve its heart.

chain.title: Still Warm, Still Beating
chain.desc: Dropped by Demons, Baphomet, Herne, Leonard and Lilith; it powers the familiar binding and the Voodoo Poppet.

chain.title: A Doll Wearing Your Enemy's Name
chain.desc: Prepare the Voodoo Poppet and bind the intended Taglock according to the book. Verify the target and effect before using it; a filled sample is specific to the creature it came from.

chain.title: The Goat Upon the Throne
chain.desc: Prepare the Summon Baphomet ritual using its exact circle, power requirement and offerings. Enter with combat supplies and a clear retreat plan; this is a major encounter, not an automatic crafting step.

chain.title: The Serpent-Wound Rod
chain.desc: Recover the Caduceus from Baphomet and read its controls and uses in the Book of Shadows. Test the staff in a safe area before making it part of your regular ritual work.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. This mod was not installed in the available instances, so this is upstream-source coverage, not local gameplay validation.

sources.scope: Version-matched recipes, English in-game guide and implementation; not installed locally.

coverage.scope: Herbs, nature-powered altar, brewing/chalk, spirit hunting and demon rituals with correct glyph activation.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
